title: Wire recipe detail bottom bar to sheet flow
description: Pass recipe and current scale into the bottom bar, replace the shopping-list stub alert with sheet presentation, and show post-success confirmation feedback from recipe detail.
acceptance_criteria: The Add to shopping list action is disabled while the recipe is loading or has no ingredients, with the specified accessibility hint for empty recipes.
`RecipeDetailSheet` passes parsed recipe and current scale through, presents the add sheet, and shows a visible success confirmation after commits.
